_source: Fiiiish Island vault raid-costs.md (re-verified Jun/Jul 2026 vs rusthelp). Building HP + explosive damage unchanged by Built Different and Common Ground updates.

targets.name: Wood Wall
targets.note: Fire arrows / incendiary is cheapest — wood burns.

targets.name: Stone Wall
targets.note: Soft (inside) side ~25% less. 2 C4 is the go-to.

targets.name: Sheet Metal Wall
targets.note: Soft side ~3 C4. Breach from inside if you can. (7 rockets leaves ~40 HP.)

targets.name: Armored Wall
targets.note: Soft side ~6 C4. Rarely worth raiding head-on.

targets.name: Wooden Door
targets.note: Fire / 16 explo. Cheapest door in the game.

targets.name: Sheet Metal Door
targets.note: Most common raid target: 1 C4 pops it.

targets.name: Stone Floor / Foundation
targets.note: Same HP as the wall of its tier. Ceiling breach into loot rooms.

targets.name: High External Wood Wall
targets.note: Wood burns — 2 incendiary rockets is cheapest. Usually laddered, not raided.

targets.name: High External Stone Wall
targets.note: Same HP as a stone wall. Ladder / gate-camp instead of raiding.

targets.name: Tool Cupboard (TC)
targets.note: The soft underbelly — 8 explo (200 sulfur) kills it. Take TC, place your own, peel the base for free.

targets.name: Auto Turret
targets.note: Better to shoot it offline than to boom it.

bradley.name: Bradley APC
bradley.note: Explosive-only. Regenerates if left 5 min. Aim rear/treads. Drops 3 crates.

methods.why: Cheapest viable kill. Misses are why guides say 4-7.
